title: Pure Hunder
summary: The Hunder family (Pahunder, Mahunder, Brohunder, and Sishunder) paired with Thunder Sea Horse, Vylon Prism, Batteryman Solar, and Recycling Batteries. Because Pahunder and Mahunder grant extra Normal Summons as Ignition Effects, summoning one chains into the next to swarm Level 4 LIGHT Thunders.

summary.title: Starters
points: Pahunder and Mahunder each activate once per turn to Normal Summon 1 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monster with 1600 or less ATK from your hand as an additional Normal Summon.
Brohunder searches any Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monster with 1600 or less ATK (Pahunder, Mahunder, Sishunder, Thunder Sea Horse, Vylon Prism, or Batteryman Solar) when Normal Summoned.

Thunder Sea Horse discards itself to add 2 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monsters with 1600 or less ATK and the same name from your Deck to your hand during a setup turn (locking Special Summons for that turn).

summary.title: Opening: Pahunder + Brohunder (or Mahunder)
steps: Normal Summon Pahunder and activate its Ignition Effect to Normal Summon Brohunder from your hand.
Brohunder's Normal Summon trigger searches Mahunder (or Level 4 Tuner Vylon Prism if you already hold Mahunder).

If you hold Mahunder, Normal Summon it via a second Pahunder or on the next chain to Normal Summon Vylon Prism or Batteryman Solar, then Synchro Summon Level 8 Crimson Blader or Xyz Summon Rank 4 Starliege Paladynamo, Bujintei Tsukuyomi, or Number 91: Thunder Spark Dragon.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Vylon Prism is a Level 4 LIGHT Thunder Tuner searchable by Brohunder and Normal Summonable off Pahunder/Mahunder; when sent from the Monster Zone to the GY for a Level 8 Synchro Summon (Crimson Blader or Scarlight Red Dragon Archfiend), it pays 500 LP to equip itself to that Synchro for +1000 ATK during damage calculation.
Starliege Paladynamo detaches 2 materials to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 and negate its effects, while Bujintei Tsukuyomi discards your remaining hand to draw 2 fresh cards.
Number 91: Thunder Spark Dragon detaches 3 materials (easily fueled by Spirit Converter) to destroy all other face-up monsters on the field, or 5 materials to destroy all cards the opponent controls.
Some Summer Summoner links off two Thunders and discards 1 card during the opponent's turn to revive a Thunder from the GY.

summary.title: Spells & Recursion
points: Recycling Batteries adds any 2 Thunder monsters with 1500 or less ATK (Pahunder, Mahunder, Brohunder, Sishunder, Vylon Prism, or Batteryman Solar) from your GY back to your hand.
Sishunder banishes a Level 4 LIGHT Thunder with 1600 or less ATK from your GY when Normal Summoned and returns it to your hand during the End Phase.
Spirit Converter attaches a Level 4 LIGHT monster you control to an Xyz Monster once per turn, and recovers 2 Level 4 LIGHT Thunder monsters from your GY when sent to the GY.
